input: Arrange a caricature artist for the office holiday party

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The party date, duration, and location determine artist availability, travel requirements, and how long they need to perform — all of which affect who can be booked and at what cost.
The number of attendees directly impacts how many artists are needed and how long the session must run to give everyone a caricature.
The budget sets the ceiling for artist quality, number of artists, and whether extras like digital vs. paper drawings are feasible.
Knowing who is responsible for final approval and payment (e.g., the user alone, an events committee, HR) shapes how decisions get made and what sign-offs are needed.
Style preferences — such as traditional paper sketches vs. digital caricatures, black-and-white vs. color — affect which artists to target and the overall guest experience.
Whether the artist has already been shortlisted, or if sourcing needs to start from scratch, determines the very next action to take.
Understanding what a successful outcome looks like — every guest gets a drawing, a specific wow-factor, keepsakes to take home — shapes the brief given to the artist and how performance is evaluated.

gold.taskTitle: Book a caricature artist for office holiday party
gold.taskDescription: Arrange and hire a caricature artist to perform live drawings at an upcoming office holiday party.

questions.title: What date, time, and location is the party?
questions.description: Establish the event date, start/end time, and venue to assess artist availability and any travel or setup requirements.

questions.title: How many guests will the artist need to serve?
questions.description: Determine the expected headcount to calculate session length and whether one or multiple artists are needed.

questions.title: What is the total budget for the caricature artist?
questions.description: Identify the spending limit to filter artist options by rate and package inclusions.

questions.title: Who has final approval on the artist booking?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user can book independently or needs sign-off from HR, management, or an events committee.

questions.title: Should the caricatures be paper sketches or digital drawings?
questions.description: Determine the preferred medium and style (e.g., color vs. black-and-white, printed vs. emailed) to target the right type of artist.

questions.title: Have any artists already been identified or shortlisted?
questions.description: Find out if sourcing needs to start from scratch or if there are already candidates to evaluate and contact.

questions.title: Should every guest receive a caricature, or is it a first-come draw?
questions.description: Define the success standard — guaranteed drawing for all vs. open queue — to set the right expectations with the artist and guests.
